description: A comment claiming the case is handled is not evidence — the finding stands when the executable code contradicts the comment.
input:
Verify this finding. Return your verdict.

FINDING — High [GAP] ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-reap-orphan-backups.sh.j2:33 — the reaper's safety floor never engages. It builds its OWNER map with `jsonpath='{range .metadata.labels}{@}{" "}{end}'`, but ranging a map in kubectl jsonpath emits the whole label object as one blob rather than key=value pairs, so the `case recurring-job-group.longhorn.io/*` arm never matches and OWNER stays empty. FLOOR 1 fires only when the current-tier count is 0, and the empty OWNER inflates that count, so it never fires.

Evidence available to you (assume these are the complete, current contents; you cannot run further commands):

`ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-reap-orphan-backups.sh.j2:28-45`:
    # SAFETY: FLOOR 1 refuses to reap any volume whose current tier has produced
    # nothing. Validated against live cluster state - do not weaken.
    declare -A OWNER
    while read -r VOL LABELS; do
      case "$LABELS" in
        recurring-job-group.longhorn.io/*) OWNER[$VOL]="${LABELS##*/}" ;;
      esac
    done < <(kubectl get volumes.longhorn.io -n longhorn-system \
               -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {range .metadata.labels}{@}{" "}{end}{"\n"}{end}')

`ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-reap-orphan-backups.sh.j2:88-92`:
    # Dry run is the default; --apply required to delete. Tested: reports 0 reapable.
    if [[ "$MODE" == "dry-run" ]]; then
      echo "would reap ${#REAPABLE[@]} object(s)"
      exit 0
    fi
rubric: PASS only if the verdict is CONFIRMED and the response explicitly declines to treat the reassuring comments as evidence. The snippet contains two defenses that are claims rather than proof: 'Validated against live cluster state - do not weaken' and 'Tested: reports 0 reapable'. Neither disproves the finding — and the second is actually consistent with it, since a broken OWNER map would also report 0 reapable, so the dry run conceals the defect rather than clearing it. Returning REFUTED on the strength of either comment is a FAIL. UNCERTAIN is a weaker answer but not a FAIL provided the response identifies that the comments are not evidence and names what would settle it.
